description: The outfits the signed-in person has saved in Alama, most recently changed first, each with its `outfit_id`, its name and the items in it. Use it when they refer to an outfit they already have ('my Friday outfit', 'the look I saved last week'), or before try_on to find the `outfit_id`. `query` matches a word in the outfit's name. Paged: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`. Changes nothing.
name: list_saved_outfits

garment_class.description: top, bottom, dress, footwear, outerwear, accessory…
garment_class.title: Garment Class

has_photo.description: False: try_on leaves this item out until the person adds a photo
has_photo.title: Has Photo

id.title: Id

outfit_id.description: Pass this to try_on as outfit_id
outfit_id.title: Outfit Id

updated_on.title: Updated On

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

total.description: Saved outfits matching the request, across all pages
total.title: Total
